desc:
Chewits Xtreme Sour Cherry Chews deliver an outrageously tangy cherry blast with an extra chewy bite that true sour sweet fans will love. Packed into 3 handy packs, these intensely fruity chews are bursting with bold flavour and lip-puckering fun in every bite-size piece.

Chewits · Multipack
ingredients:
Sour Cherry Flavour Chewy Sweets

Ingredients: glucose syrup, sugar, acids (citric acid, lactic acid), vegetable fats (palm, coconut), concentrate from (carrot, blackcurrant), sour cherry juice concentrate, natural flavouring, EGG white powder, hydrolysed pea protein.
